'''2018 MPC Chris Westergard DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Westergard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Westergard DS 2018 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2018-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
